dogecoin.text: @JBougearel You sound like a smart guy, just remember that price of something doesn't validate it's value. Dogecoin is a perfect example. Completely worthless crypto but is worth billions (at the moment). The market will get more efficient at pricing over time and reward true value.
I wish @elonmusk took #crypto seriously... if he did, he wouldn't be promoting shitcoins like #dogecoin, instead, he'd be educating people about quality projects like #Ergo.
